note: PostgreSQL joins bare query terms with AND, so a natural-language question needs every word present. 'migration rules' and 'connection pool size' returned nothing at all.

strategy: full-text, any-term fallback when the strict query finds nothing
note: Precision is preserved for queries that match strictly; the widening only happens when the alternative is returning nothing. Stale inclusion stayed at exactly zero, which is the useful part: loosening the match did not loosen the correctness guarantee, because suppression is structural rather than a ranking effect.
